_provenance: Neural control of a fixed body. The brain's ONLY job is to produce coordinated forward motion — distance, straightness, and periodicity (rhythm, not noise). The body is fixed (walker.trained.json); the brain co-evolves WITH it, not independently.

walls.periodicity: The footfall signal MUST contain a cycle. Below 0.30 autocorrelation means the support pattern is white noise that happens to travel — a convulsion, not a gait. The FIRST brain_gpu winner scored 0.25 on this measure and the studio called it 'a seizure with good PR.' This wall is WHY brain_gpu exists: the old brain.json never rewarded rhythm, so nothing ever stopped the brain from being noise.
walls.duty_factor: At least one foot MUST spend meaningful time on the ground. Below 0.10 means every limb is in ballistic flight — the creature never loads a leg. A walker that never touches the ground is a projectile, not an animal.
walls.sleds: The body MUST NOT drag. A sled is a limb locked at >92% duty — it never lifts. One sled means a tripod with a tail; more than one means the creature is a sled, not a walker. A sled scores perfect on straightness and never falls over; that is exactly why this wall exists.
walls.robustness: The brain MUST produce a limit cycle, not a lottery ticket. The worst of 16 randomized start poses must reach at least 25% of the mean distance. A brain that only works from one exact pose is a memorized sequence, not a controller.
walls.energy: Joint work MUST stay bounded. Above 150 J per meter travelled means every actuator is fighting — the brain is not coordinating, it is flailing at maximum torque. The body's own CPG walker scores ~80; 150 leaves room for neural exploration while walling out thermonuclear seizure.
